channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: ICE operations are encroaching on schools and day cares
item.description: Day cares in Minnesota say ICE is targeting their workers.

item.title: Twins agree with veteran catcher Victor Caratini on two-year contract
item.description: Caratini, whose contract is worth $14 million, had his best offensive season in 2025 while playing for Houston.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves’ sloppiness costly in 110-105 loss at Houston
item.description: Again playing without Anthony Edwards, the Wolves missed 15 free throws and committed 16 turnovers against the Rockets.

item.title: Natural gas pipeline explosion rocks east-central Minnesota town
item.description: No injuries were reported but more than 600 Minnesota Energy Resources customers were without heat.

item.title: Tribal leader walks back claims DHS isn’t cooperating with search for members thought detained
item.description: The Oglala Sioux Tribe and feds are still working to verify the tribe’s initial reports that four of its members had been detained in Minneapolis.

item.title: Minnesota Republicans stand with Trump, ICE after fatal shooting and threat of Insurrection Act
item.description: Democrats say the GOP will pay a “significant political price” for the aggressive immigration enforcement operation.

item.title: University of Minnesota offers online classes for students who feel unsafe amid ICE surge
item.description: The U’s Twin Cities campus will offer the online option to students at the campus, which resumes classes Jan. 20.

item.title: ICE agents eat at small-town Mexican restaurant — then detain workers
item.description: “Would your mama be proud of you right now?” a bystander said as agents returned at closing time to nab the workers.

item.title: Fire Department report: Renee Good had four wounds from gunshots; 911 dispatch details chaotic scene
item.description: Newly acquired documents describe Good’s injuries after she was shot by an ICE agent Jan. 7.

item.title: The latest: DOJ reportedly investigating Walz, Frey for obstructing federal law enforcement
item.description: A federal judge is prohibiting ICE agents from “retaliating” against peaceful protesters and observers.
